target_statement: In mathlib's GHSpace (genuine metric space of nonempty compact metric spaces up to isometry, complete + second-countable): (1) converse of Gromov's compactness criterion (total boundedness <=> uniform diameter bound + uniform covering-number bounds) via new coupling-level cover/diameter transfer lemmas; (2) closed + uniform diameter/covering bounds ==> IsCompact, plus explicit strictly-monotone subsequence/convergence witnesses expressed in ghDist; (3) nondegenerate model: the family of unit-square grids (mesh 1/(n+1)) in EuclideanSpace R (Fin 2) has uniform covering numbers with unbounded cardinality and converges in ghDist to the Euclidean unit square (explicit limit witness); (4) equicontinuity route via Arzela-Ascoli for metric structures on Fin N (if time); (5) Frontier module: statement-only Cheeger-Gromov missing steps (harmonic coordinates, elliptic estimates, Bishop-Gromov, injectivity radius from kappa-noncollapsing) and the ancient-kappa/canonical-neighborhood dependency design linking to D9's state-only Props. Nothing assumes a convergent subsequence as data.

approach: Metric-level: prove the converse of Gromov's criterion in GHSpace through coupling-transfer lemmas (cover + diameter transfer across ghDist < r via the optimal coupling); assemble compactness via upstream totallyBounded + CompleteSpace GHSpace; extraction via IsCompact.tendsto_subseq. Model-level: unit-square grid family (finite grids, induced Euclidean metric) — explicit uniform covering function K(eps) = (ceil(4/eps)+1)^2 via square grid denseness, uniform diam sqrt 2, explicit ghDist convergence to the Euclidean square, and proof the family is infinite (cardinality (n+2)^2 unbounded) so no trivial finite bound applies. Frontier: named statement-only interfaces for Cheeger-Gromov smooth/gauge/curvature steps and ancient-kappa/canonical-neighborhood, consumed-by-design by the metric lemmas; no claims.
